netbird.desc: NetBird builds a WireGuard overlay network. Enroll this router with a setup key to reach your LAN remotely, use NetBird routes and exit nodes, or let this router serve as an exit node for your peers.
netbird.not_installed_hint: The NetBird binary is not installed. Run install.sh from the netbird-glinet-openwrt repository on your computer.
netbird.swap_hint: Only {avail} RAM available and no swap. NetBird may get killed by the kernel when memory runs out. Plug in a USB stick and run `netbird-setup-swap` over SSH.
netbird.mgmt_url_hint: Must include the port, e.g. https://api.netbird.io:443 or https://netbird.example.com:443.
netbird.setup_key_hint: NetBird dashboard → Setup Keys → create a Reusable key. Leave empty to reconnect with the existing enrollment.
netbird.procd_hint: procd: supervised by the system service manager and restarted on crash
netbird.exit_need_token: To toggle the exit node from here, store a NetBird API token under Advanced settings and create an exit-node route for this router in the dashboard.
netbird.hostname_hint: Shown in the dashboard. Empty = system hostname.
netbird.gogc_hint: Lower values use less RAM and slightly more CPU. Default 50.
netbird.gomemlimit_hint: Soft heap limit for the daemon, e.g. 48MiB. Empty = unlimited.
netbird.api_token_hint: Dashboard → avatar → API tokens. Enables the exit-node switch. Stored on the router only.
netbird.disable_client_routes_hint: Recommended on. Otherwise another peer's exit-node route can take over this router's uplink.
netbird.disable_server_routes: Do not act as router for peers
netbird.disable_server_routes_hint: On = this router never forwards traffic for peers (no LAN access, no exit node).
netbird.disable_dns_hint: On = no peer names and no DNS routes on this router.
netbird.lan_dns_forward: Forward NetBird domains for LAN clients
netbird.lan_dns_forward_hint: dnsmasq sends NetBird peer names and DNS routes to the NetBird resolver, so every LAN device can resolve them.
netbird.firewall_zone_hint: Creates zone 'netbird' with masquerading and lan→netbird / netbird→wan forwarding.
netbird.block_lan_access_hint: Peers may still use routes, but cannot reach this router's LAN.
netbird.wg_userspace_hint: Only if the kernel module causes trouble. Uses more CPU and RAM.
netbird.disable_ebpf_proxy_hint: Keep on for kernels older than 5.x (GL.iNet 18.06/21.02 firmware).
netbird.restart_hint: Saving restarts the NetBird service when a setting changed.
netbird.msg_invalid_url: Enter a valid URL with port, e.g. https://api.netbird.io:443
netbird.hw_switch_hint: When the toggle switch is set to "VPN client" in System → Toggle Button Settings, it also turns NetBird on and off.
netbird.networks_hint: Routes and exit nodes your management server offers this router. Switch one on to route through it; LAN clients follow automatically.
netbird.networks_disabled_hint: Client routes are disabled in Advanced settings — enable them to use networks and exit nodes.
netbird.hw_switch_mode_hint: What the hardware switch controls when set to "VPN client".
